note: COMPUTED from a firearm's introduction year — never authored (SPEC.md §7). The buckets are cut where small-arms design actually changed rather than at round decades: smokeless powder in 1886 and the intermediate cartridge in 1945 are the two real discontinuities, and a decade grid would hide both. The lower bound is the self-contained metallic cartridge (~1860s), which is the scope floor in SPEC.md §15.

terms.label: Metallic cartridge
terms.description: Self-contained cartridges and black powder. Cartridge conversions and the first practical repeaters.

terms.label: Smokeless revolution
terms.description: Smokeless powder, small-bore bolt actions, the first self-loaders.

terms.label: Early Cold War
terms.description: The intermediate cartridge becomes standard; stamped and pressed construction.

terms.label: Post-Cold War
terms.description: Polymer frames, modular rails, optics as standard issue.
